name: Marina Vendrell
description: A teenage girl whose diary tells how she befriended the bound Valgavoth, was bullied, and let him take four classmates; the House protects her.

description_citations.work: Duskmourn: House of Horror | Episode 5: Don't Give In
description_citations.text: "Duskmourn: House of Horror | Episode 5: Don't Give In" by Mira Grant. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Aug 2024.

timeline.summary: In a flashback many years ago, a family arrives at an old house; the door swings open of its own accord to welcome them.
timeline.quote: the door swung open of its own accord, as if to welcome them home

citation.work: Duskmourn: House of Horror | Episode 1: Don't Go Past the Old Dark House
citation.text: "Duskmourn: House of Horror | Episode 1: Don't Go Past the Old Dark House " by Mira Grant. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 19 Aug 2024.

timeline.summary: In the flashback, Marina notices the basement door standing ajar and senses that something patient waits below.
timeline.quote: That door stood ajar, revealing a thin slice of stairs descending into the darkness.

citation.work: Duskmourn: House of Horror | Episode 1: Don't Go Past the Old Dark House
citation.text: "Duskmourn: House of Horror | Episode 1: Don't Go Past the Old Dark House " by Mira Grant. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 19 Aug 2024.

timeline.summary: Tyvar and Zimone find an impossible sunlit room where a teenage girl writes in a diary.
timeline.quote: Sunlight streamed through the two closed windows, bathing the teenage girl who sat on one of the larger couches

citation.work: Duskmourn: House of Horror | Episode 5: Don't Give In
citation.text: "Duskmourn: House of Horror | Episode 5: Don't Give In" by Mira Grant. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Aug 2024.

timeline.summary: When the girl leaves, the room turns back into a rotting House room with blood in her footprints.
timeline.quote: Clouds immediately choked the sky outside, swallowing the sunlight

citation.work: Duskmourn: House of Horror | Episode 5: Don't Give In
citation.text: "Duskmourn: House of Horror | Episode 5: Don't Give In" by Mira Grant. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Aug 2024.

timeline.summary: Zimone realizes the girl repels the House and asks Tyvar to drop his camouflage.
timeline.quote: Whatever she is, she's repelling the House.

citation.work: Duskmourn: House of Horror | Episode 5: Don't Give In
citation.text: "Duskmourn: House of Horror | Episode 5: Don't Give In" by Mira Grant. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Aug 2024.

timeline.summary: Marina sees the strangers and screams; they introduce themselves.

citation.work: Duskmourn: House of Horror | Episode 5: Don't Give In
citation.text: "Duskmourn: House of Horror | Episode 5: Don't Give In" by Mira Grant. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Aug 2024.

timeline.summary: Marina explains An Architectural Accounting, the book Zimone found, and admits to annotating it.
timeline.quote: That was started by the last person to live here.

citation.work: Duskmourn: House of Horror | Episode 5: Don't Give In
citation.text: "Duskmourn: House of Horror | Episode 5: Don't Give In" by Mira Grant. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Aug 2024.

timeline.summary: Marina denies the truth, chanting that they are not real, and the room erupts with nightmare beasts.
timeline.quote: You're not real, you're not here, you're not real, you're not here.

citation.work: Duskmourn: House of Horror | Episode 5: Don't Give In
citation.text: "Duskmourn: House of Horror | Episode 5: Don't Give In" by Mira Grant. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Aug 2024.

timeline.summary: The diary reveals that Marina met Valgavoth, a demon summoned and bound in the house by an earlier owner.
timeline.quote: His name is Valgavoth—Val—and he was summoned here and bound by one of the owners before us.

citation.work: Duskmourn: House of Horror | Episode 5: Don't Give In
citation.text: "Duskmourn: House of Horror | Episode 5: Don't Give In" by Mira Grant. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Aug 2024.

timeline.summary: Marina chooses not to free Valgavoth because he is her only friend.
timeline.quote: Val is the only real friend I've made since we moved here.

citation.work: Duskmourn: House of Horror | Episode 5: Don't Give In
citation.text: "Duskmourn: House of Horror | Episode 5: Don't Give In" by Mira Grant. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Aug 2024.

timeline.summary: After being bullied, Marina decides to invite her tormentors home and let Valgavoth make them pay.
timeline.quote: I'll invite them over tomorrow after school.

citation.work: Duskmourn: House of Horror | Episode 5: Don't Give In
citation.text: "Duskmourn: House of Horror | Episode 5: Don't Give In" by Mira Grant. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Aug 2024.

timeline.summary: Valgavoth takes the girls, pulling them into the walls.
timeline.quote: He took them. Hands reached out of the walls and grabbed them

citation.work: Duskmourn: House of Horror | Episode 5: Don't Give In
citation.text: "Duskmourn: House of Horror | Episode 5: Don't Give In" by Mira Grant. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Aug 2024.

timeline.summary: Marina realizes Valgavoth has become the house and is eating the world around him.
timeline.quote: I think Val is the house, somehow, after all this time

citation.work: Duskmourn: House of Horror | Episode 5: Don't Give In
citation.text: "Duskmourn: House of Horror | Episode 5: Don't Give In" by Mira Grant. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Aug 2024.

relations.note: The House protects Marina and attacks her visitors.

citation.work: Duskmourn: House of Horror | Episode 5: Don't Give In
citation.text: "Duskmourn: House of Horror | Episode 5: Don't Give In" by Mira Grant. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Aug 2024.

relations.note: Made a similar promise to Marina years ago.
relations.quote: I promised you what I promised my Marina, so many years ago

citation.work: Duskmourn: House of Horror | Episode 6: Don't Die
citation.text: "Duskmourn: House of Horror | Episode 6: Don't Die" by Mira Grant. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 Aug 2024.

relations.quote: Winter now believes that defeating Marina Vendrell will reverse all the deaths caused by her control over Valgavoth.

citation.text: "The Legends of Reality Fracture" by Meris Mullaley, Christopher Stuart-Reckling, K. Arsenault Rivera, DK Billins. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 Sep 2026.
